reason: A DSH web client plugin for discovering, toggling, repositioning, resizing, collision-avoiding, and arranging platform and plugin UI elements in the browser page.

summaries.zh: 用于统一发现、开关、拖拽、调整大小并自动排布 DSH 网页中的官方和插件界面元素。
summaries.en: A DSH web client plugin for discovering, toggling, dragging, resizing, and automatically arranging official and plugin UI elements.

capabilities: Discovers plugin and platform UI elements in the page DOM
Shows or hides individual UI elements and their child controls
Changes UI position and size through DOM attributes, CSS variables, transforms, and fixed positioning
Stores display, layout, size, and panel state in browser localStorage
Intercepts pointer input while drag mode is enabled
Exposes a browser-side JavaScript API for UI management
